cases.purpose: Every candidate has an official source, exact reference, version and license disposition.
Research candidates can inform an offline reference or shadow comparison without becoming a SimWar writer.
The current JSON/Core path remains runnable when every candidate is unavailable.
Unverified license, release, maintenance, SLO or hardware claims remain WATCH and cannot enter dependencies.
Vendor benchmark, throughput and hardware statements are recorded as source claims only and are not SimWar SLOs.

non_proofs: This manifest does not activate a dependency or Provider.
This manifest does not prove model quality, calibration, SLO, hardware performance or Human Validation.
This manifest does not authorize a model to write Settlement, Enterprise State, Score, Rank or Replay truth.
Research references do not replace current SimWar source, contracts, tests or runtime evidence.
recheck_policy: Re-run on a new current-master baseline, new upstream release, license change, maintenance signal, dependency request or owner baseline replacement.
